name: io.github.RunOnFlux/flux-cloud-mcp
title: Flux Cloud
description: Deploy, pay for and manage apps on Flux Cloud, the decentralized cloud. Prices in USD.

environmentVariables.name: FLUX_ID_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: WIF private key of the Flux ID that owns your apps. Optional; read-only tools work without it. flux_generate_keys creates one.

environmentVariables.name: FLUX_PAYMENT_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: WIF private key of the Flux address that pays deployment fees. Optional; fund it with only what you intend to spend.
